answer_1.quote: In this study, we aim to distill LLMs' text summarization prowess into a more compact local model... we introduce a three-step framework TriSum ... for abstractive text summarization.

answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics: (1) ROUGE-F1: measures the overlap of n-grams between the generated summary and the reference summary. ... (2) BERTScore and BARTScore: measure the semantic similarity between the generated summary and the reference summary using pre-trained language models.
